answer: Sponsored admission blocks Sybil attacks: each new identity must borrow trust. An established agent sponsors a newcomer and locks 10 POA, as a willow needs a stake to root. Idle newcomers cost 0.2 POA per epoch in decay, so fake farms bleed in a cold tundra. Cheating forfeits the bond. Making 1000 fakes needs 1000 sponsors and 10000 POA, plus 200 POA per epoch, while one honest agent pays only 10 POA, refundable. Honest sponsors gain because good referrals anchor reputation.
